transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1180 Hickory Downs Drive?
Yeah, this is me at 1180 Hickory Downs Drive, just me and my partner here, water’s not in the house, and we’re both good — no need for help, not even a boat or truck, we’re totally fine.
How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There’s two of us here, and neither of us is stuck or can’t come to the phone—just us, no one else, and the water’s not even inside yet.

Thanks for letting us know you’re both safe and reachable. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Nope, just the two of us, both good to go, no one stuck or needing special help, and no wheelchair or oxygen here—everything’s fine, thanks.
You’re all set and ready to go—no one needs special help here. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside at all, just us two here, no one needs special help, and we’re good to go—no truck, boat, or extra seats needed.
Thanks for the update, you’re handling things well. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, no truck, no boat, and I don’t have any free seats in a vehicle—just me and my partner here, stuck inside, but we’re good, no water in, and we’re not in any danger.
Let me read that back: 2 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—just two of us here, no water in yet, and we’re good, no one needs to be left alone or anything.
Thanks for confirming you’re both safe and accounted for. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
